key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How frequently the network speed is polled from /proc/net/dev. Lower values give more responsive readings but consume more CPU. Recommended range: 1000–3000.

key.name: use-bits
key.summary: Display speed in bits per second
key.description: When true, speeds are shown in Kbps/Mbps (bits). When false, speeds are shown in KB/s/MB/s (bytes). Default is bytes (false).

key.name: show-upload
key.description: Whether to display the upload (TX) speed in the panel.

key.name: show-download
key.description: Whether to display the download (RX) speed in the panel.

key.name: monitored-interface
key.description: Specific interface name (e.g. wlan0, eth0, tun0) or empty string to sum all active interfaces.

key.name: data-quota-gb
key.description: Monthly data usage limit in Gigabytes. Set to 0 to disable data quota warnings.

key.name: quota-notify
key.description: Whether to trigger system desktop notifications when reaching 80% and 100% data quota.

key.name: auto-hide-idle
key.summary: Auto-hide panel when network is idle
key.description: Whether to hide the indicator from top panel when overall network speed is below threshold.

key.name: idle-threshold-kb
key.description: Speed threshold in KB/s below which the indicator is hidden when auto-hide is enabled.

key.name: adaptive-power-saver
key.description: Automatically increases polling interval when on battery power or metered connection to save battery and data.

key.name: show-top-apps
key.description: Inspect and display top bandwidth consuming processes in the menu dashboard.
